name: CosVoice API
description: A CosVoice line is one phone number and one email address belonging to one assistant. Ask it to call someone in plain English; it holds the conversation, then writes up what happened. Calls take minutes: place a call, then poll GET /calls/{id} or wait for the call.completed webhook. Get a key at https://cosvoice.com/desk/settings (Connect your agent). Send it as an Authorization: Bearer header. Rate limit: 240 requests a minute per key.
